title: limonium carnosum
intro: Limonium carnosum, commonly known as Sea Lavender, is a flowering plant in the family Plumbaginaceae. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Limonium carnosum include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
